## How the score was worked out

Each result implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average, with a small pull toward the middle for thinly tested models. Each test's weight is its *counts* column above; here it is added up by who ran the tests. [Method](../method.md)

<pre>
source                                   results  share of the score

prior: pull toward the middle                       1% ▇
weighted average                                  = 61.1
</pre>

## How to run it

### Through an API

api (Cloudflare) · $0.038/M input tokens · [developers.cloudflare.com](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/models/clef-flash/)

<sub>[price source](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/models/clef-flash): Cloudflare Workers AI list price, observed 2026-10-31. USD per million input tokens, including tokenized media; no output-token charge. Not a fixed price per decision. · [context source](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/models/clef-flash): Cloudflare hosted endpoint limit, observed 2026-10-31. State, questions and tokenized media share the context window; this is not a local-memory guarantee.</sub>

### Other ways to run it

1. Run it as published (BF16, needs ~24.6 GB, NVIDIA only, from [huggingface.co/Cloudflare](https://huggingface.co/Cloudflare/clef-flash/blob/fb4417d31c1d0f9e7e77f1141b40aaede7491e00/README.md))
   
   ```sh
   docker run --gpus all --shm-size 32g -p 30000:30000 -v ~/.cache/huggingface:/root/.cache/huggingface --ipc=host lmsysorg/sglang:dev-clef sglang serve --model-path Cloudflare/clef-flash --host 0.0.0.0 --port 30000
   ```

Official weights and documentation: [huggingface.co/Cloudflare](https://huggingface.co/Cloudflare/clef-flash)
